convention: X = q_a + i q_b, Y = k_a + i k_b (half-split planes, gains folded), Z = X Y^H, score = sum_j Re(e^{-i w_j t} x^T Z_j y)/sqrt(hd), t = key pos - query pos
rank_threshold: tau = max(rows, cols) eps_f64 sigma_1 (stacks); n eps lambda_max (Grams)
exactness: exact: bias-free, no q/k norm, so scores are exactly the complex bilinear sum and the native edit is exact

executed_edit.rotary: cos/sin in float64 from the model's own float32 inv_freq buffer
executed_edit.softmax: eager attention with the softmax in float64 (eager casts it to float32); logits captured
executed_edit.input_norm: RMSNorm computed in float64 by the script (HF's upcasts to float32); attention module is HF's
